overviewHtml:
Analyzing Dynatrace Platform Subscription usage often means leaving the terminal and clicking through the UI. A scripted query makes the data easy to reuse in reports and automation.

What you get

  • One-command connection to your Dynatrace platform
  • DQL query run directly from the terminal
  • Output in your preferred format, such as JSON or CSV
  • Sample demo.dql query to start from
prereqsHtml:
• dtctl installed
  • A Dynatrace environment URL (e.g. https://abc12345.apps.dynatrace.com)

See SETUP.md for step-by-step instructions.
getStartedHtml:
You need dtctl and your Dynatrace environment URL.

  1. Install dtctl
  2. Connect it to your environment
  3. Run the sample DQL query and choose an output format

Full setup instructions are in the README.
